scripts.test: npm --workspace packages/core run test && npm --workspace packages/contracts run test && npm --workspace app run test
scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:server & npm run dev
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm --workspace desktop run start
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm --workspace desktop run dist
scripts.desktop:install: rm -rf ~/Applications/Headroom.app && ditto desktop/dist/mac-arm64/Headroom.app ~/Applications/Headroom.app && echo Headroom liegt jetzt in ~/Applications
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace packages/core run typecheck && npm --workspace packages/contracts run typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p app/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json
